description: Scottish Water's Sewer Catchments is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Scottish Water Sewer Catchment Areas are also known as Drainage operational Areas (DOAs). A Drainage operational Area (DOA) is defined as the geographic area which encloses all the wastewater assets, properties and ground surfaces that deliver flow to a single Sewage Treatment Works (STW) or a Public Septic Tank (PST). Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are INSPIRE, Open Data, Scottish Water, Utility and governmental services, Waste Water Sewer. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
